content: Bellwood General Hospital was a medical facility located in Bellflower, California. It ceased operations on April 6, 2003. On February 2, 1982, the hospital was acquired by Paracelsus Healthcare Corporation. This corporation, which was later renamed Clarent Hospital Corporation, eventually ceased its business operations. The cessation followed an agreement to pay $7.3 million to resolve allegations of Medicare fraud involving two of its facilities: Orange County Community Hospital (OCCH) and Bellwood General Hospital. As part of its bankruptcy proceedings, the company either sold or closed all of its hospitals, with Bellwood General Hospital being among those that were shut down. However, Bellwood Health Facility, a psychiatric health facility licensed by the Office of Statewide Health Planning and Development (OSHPD), continues to operate adjacent to the original site of Bellwood General Hospital.
